title: Fonts
summary: Inter for the Claude app UI (tabs, buttons, your messages, the composer) and Source Serif 4 for Claude's replies, the closest free stand-ins for Anthropic Sans and Anthropic Serif; JetBrains Mono for Claude Code in the terminal; Instrument Serif for a style card.
usage: UI text uses Inter (ui.js F); anything Claude says uses Source Serif 4 (ui.js FS, say()). Inter Tight stays for older pieces and frames.

items.note: UI face: tabs, buttons, your message pills, the composer. Stand-in for Anthropic Sans.
Claude's replies (the app's default serif chat font). Stand-in for Anthropic Serif.
